# Reviewed Android mGBA cores

These unmodified Libretro mGBA archives are retained for reproducible,
user-initiated Broomm setup. The Flutter application downloads the selected
archive through an immutable Git commit URL. This directory is excluded
from Flutter's bundled assets.

The build identifies itself as `0.11-212-7a12d6d`. Archive and payload
checksums, original URLs, capture dates and exact source identity are in
[provenance.json](provenance.json). Preserve this version's bytes.

The core is distributed under [MPL 2.0](LICENSE). Its corresponding source,
including the upstream third-party notices and libretro build recipe, is
available in the [exact source archive](https://github.com/libretro/mgba/archive/7a12d6d4b9acb14c0ae62c9166b6a2f3d08007f6.tar.gz).
Broomm makes no modifications to the binaries or their upstream sources.
